    matK[6,1] := 0.0450; matK[6,2] := 0.0850; matK[6,3] := 0.000320; matK[6,4] := 0.0120;

    (* Initialize MPC Quadratic Weight Arrays *)

    arrHessianDiag[1] := arrWeightR[1] + arrWeightS[1] + 12.5;

(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 3: DEEP-SEA HYDROSTATIC & GEOTHERMAL PLUME THERMAL CORRECTION

(* Seawater Density Equation of State at 400.0 bar hydrostatic and 2.0 deg C ambient *)
rSeawaterDensity_kg_m3 := 1028.5 + (0.0452 * rAmbientPressure_bar) - (0.0058 * rVentFluidTemp_degC);

rCompensatedOilDensity := 875.0 * (1.0 + (0.000062 * (rSupplyPressure_bar + rAmbientPressure_bar)));
rDynamicViscosity_cSt  := 32.0 * EXP(-0.028 * (rHydraulicOilTemp_degC - 40.0)) * (1.0 + (0.0018 * rSupplyPressure_bar));

(* Hydrothermal Vent Plume Thermal Shock Detection at Wire Guide Nozzles *)
IF rVentFluidTemp_degC > 280.0 THEN

(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 4: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) VOTING & FAULT ISOLATION ENGINE
   Executes high-integrity majority voting across triple load cells and AE transducers.
   Detects drift, channel deviation, isolates faulty transmitters, and fails over gracefully.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculate Pairwise Channel Discrepancies for Wire Tension Load Cells *)
rTensionDev_12 := ABS(rWireTension_CH1_N - rWireTension_CH2_N);
rTensionDev_23 := ABS(rWireTension_CH2_N - rWireTension_CH3_N);
rTensionDev_31 := ABS(rWireTension_CH3_N - rWireTension_CH1_N);

bTensionCh1_Healthy := TRUE;
bTensionCh2_Healthy := TRUE;
bTensionCh3_Healthy := TRUE;

(* Individual Channel Plausibility Boundary Checks (100 N to 25,000 N) *)
IF (rWireTension_CH1_N < 100.0) OR (rWireTension_CH1_N > 25000.0) THEN bTensionCh1_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rWireTension_CH2_N < 100.0) OR (rWireTension_CH2_N > 25000.0) THEN bTensionCh2_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rWireTension_CH3_N < 100.0) OR (rWireTension_CH3_N > 25000.0) THEN bTensionCh3_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;

(* Cross-Channel Deviation Screening *)
IF (rTensionDev_12 > rTensionThreshold_N) AND (rTensionDev_31 > rTensionThreshold_N) THEN
    bTensionCh1_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel 1 drifted away from 2 and 3 *)
END_IF;
IF (rTensionDev_12 > rTensionThreshold_N) AND (rTensionDev_23 > rTensionThreshold_N) THEN
    bTensionCh2_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel 2 drifted away from 1 and 3 *)
END_IF;
IF (rTensionDev_23 > rTensionThreshold_N) AND (rTensionDev_31 > rTensionThreshold_N) THEN
    bTensionCh3_Healthy := FALSE; (* Channel 3 drifted away from 1 and 2 *)
END_IF;

(* Count Validated Healthy Channels *)
iTensionHealthyCount := 0;
IF bTensionCh1_Healthy THEN iTensionHealthyCount := iTensionHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTensionCh2_Healthy THEN iTensionHealthyCount := iTensionHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bTensionCh3_Healthy THEN iTensionHealthyCount := iTensionHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Execute 2oo3 / Degraded 1oo2 / Fallback Voting *)
IF iTensionHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* All 3 Channels Healthy: Median Select Algorithm *)
    IF ((rWireTension_CH1_N >= rWireTension_CH2_N) AND (rWireTension_CH1_N <= rWireTension_CH3_N)) OR
       ((rWireTension_CH1_N <= rWireTension_CH2_N) AND (rWireTension_CH1_N >= rWireTension_CH3_N)) THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH1_N;
    ELSIF ((rWireTension_CH2_N >= rWireTension_CH1_N) AND (rWireTension_CH2_N <= rWireTension_CH3_N)) OR
          ((rWireTension_CH2_N <= rWireTension_CH1_N) AND (rWireTension_CH2_N >= rWireTension_CH3_N)) THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH2_N;
    ELSE
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH3_N;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := FALSE;
    bAlarm_TMR_TensionDivergence := FALSE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0002;
ELSIF iTensionHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Mode: Average of the Two Functional Transducers *)
    IF bTensionCh1_Healthy AND bTensionCh2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := (rWireTension_CH1_N + rWireTension_CH2_N) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bTensionCh2_Healthy AND bTensionCh3_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := (rWireTension_CH2_N + rWireTension_CH3_N) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedTension_N := (rWireTension_CH1_N + rWireTension_CH3_N) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    bAlarm_TMR_TensionDivergence := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: TMR Tension Sensor Degraded *)
ELSE
    (* Critical Sensor Fault: Single Channel or Total Failure - Trip Permissive *)
    IF bTensionCh1_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH1_N;
    ELSIF bTensionCh2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH2_N;
    ELSIF bTensionCh3_Healthy THEN
        rVotedTension_N := rWireTension_CH3_N;
    ELSE
        rVotedTension_N := 0.0;
        bInternalTripLatch := TRUE; (* Lockout system on total loss of tension feedback *)
    END_IF;
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    bAlarm_TMR_TensionDivergence := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0002;
END_IF;

(* 2oo3 Majority Voting on Seafloor Acoustic Emission Transducer Array *)
rAEDev_12 := ABS(rAcousticEmission_dB - rAE_Channel2_dB);
rAEDev_23 := ABS(rAE_Channel2_dB - rAE_Channel3_dB);
rAEDev_31 := ABS(rAE_Channel3_dB - rAcousticEmission_dB);

bAECh1_Healthy := (rAcousticEmission_dB >= 10.0) AND (rAcousticEmission_dB <= 120.0);
bAECh2_Healthy := (rAE_Channel2_dB >= 10.0) AND (rAE_Channel2_dB <= 120.0);
bAECh3_Healthy := (rAE_Channel3_dB >= 10.0) AND (rAE_Channel3_dB <= 120.0);

IF (rAEDev_12 > rAEThreshold_dB) AND (rAEDev_31 > rAEThreshold_dB) THEN bAECh1_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rAEDev_12 > rAEThreshold_dB) AND (rAEDev_23 > rAEThreshold_dB) THEN bAECh2_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;
IF (rAEDev_23 > rAEThreshold_dB) AND (rAEDev_31 > rAEThreshold_dB) THEN bAECh3_Healthy := FALSE; END_IF;

iAEHealthyCount := 0;
IF bAECh1_Healthy THEN iAEHealthyCount := iAEHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bAECh2_Healthy THEN iAEHealthyCount := iAEHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bAECh3_Healthy THEN iAEHealthyCount := iAEHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iAEHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    (* Triple Channel Median *)
    IF ((rAcousticEmission_dB >= rAE_Channel2_dB) AND (rAcousticEmission_dB <= rAE_Channel3_dB)) OR
       ((rAcousticEmission_dB <= rAE_Channel2_dB) AND (rAcousticEmission_dB >= rAE_Channel3_dB)) THEN
        rVotedAE_dB := rAcousticEmission_dB;
    ELSIF ((rAE_Channel2_dB >= rAcousticEmission_dB) AND (rAE_Channel2_dB <= rAE_Channel3_dB)) OR
          ((rAE_Channel2_dB <= rAcousticEmission_dB) AND (rAE_Channel2_dB >= rAE_Channel3_dB)) THEN
        rVotedAE_dB := rAE_Channel2_dB;
    ELSE
        rVotedAE_dB := rAE_Channel3_dB;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_TMR_AE_Divergence := FALSE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0004;
ELSIF iAEHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    IF bAECh1_Healthy AND bAECh2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedAE_dB := (rAcousticEmission_dB + rAE_Channel2_dB) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bAECh2_Healthy AND bAECh3_Healthy THEN
        rVotedAE_dB := (rAE_Channel2_dB + rAE_Channel3_dB) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedAE_dB := (rAcousticEmission_dB + rAE_Channel3_dB) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    bAlarm_TMR_AE_Divergence := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: TMR AE Sensor Degraded *)
ELSE
    rVotedAE_dB := rAcousticEmission_dB; (* Fallback *)
    bAlarm_TMR_AE_Divergence := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0004;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 5: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & KALMAN FILTER PREDICTOR-CORRECTOR
   Computes state prediction, innovation residual vector, and updates a posteriori estimates:
   x_hat(k) = A*x_hat(k-1) + B*u(k-1) + K*(y_meas(k) - C*(A*x_hat(k-1) + B*u(k-1)))
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Assemble Current Measurement Vector y_meas *)
vecY_meas[1] := rWireLinearSpeed_mps;
vecY_meas[2] := rFeedPosition_mm;
vecY_meas[3] := rVotedTension_N;
vecY_meas[4] := rSupplyPressure_bar - rReturnPressure_bar; (* Measured Differential Pressure *)

(* A Priori State Prediction: vecX_pred = matA * vecX_hat + matB * vecU *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matA[iRow, iCol] * vecX_hat[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matB[iRow, iCol] * vecU[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecX_pred[iRow] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Output Prediction: vecY_pred = matC * vecX_pred *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matC[iRow, iCol] * vecX_pred[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecY_pred[iRow] := rTempSum;
    (* Innovation Vector: vecY_innov = vecY_meas - vecY_pred *)
    vecY_innov[iRow] := vecY_meas[iRow] - vecY_pred[iRow];
END_FOR;

(* A Posteriori State Update: vecX_hat = vecX_pred + matK * vecY_innov *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (matK[iRow, iCol] * vecY_innov[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    vecX_hat[iRow] := vecX_pred[iRow] + rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Extract Filtered Estimates for Supervisory Control and Diagnostics *)
rEstimatedKerfDepth_mm   := vecX_hat[2];
rKerfSlurryDensity_kg_m3 := 1028.5 + (vecX_hat[5] * 32.5); (* Particulate slurry density scaling *)
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 6: VARIABLE DISPLACEMENT HYDRAULIC MOTOR ANTI-STALL TORQUE GOVERNOR
   High-speed dynamic torque limiting preventing diamond bead stripping and spindle stall.
   Calculates differential pressure rise rate (dP/dt), shaft deceleration rate (dOmega/dt),
   and dynamically de-strokes the motor swashplate while throttling feed cylinder advance.
   ========================================================================================= *)
rDiffPressure_bar := rSupplyPressure_bar - rReturnPressure_bar;
IF rDiffPressure_bar < 0.0 THEN rDiffPressure_bar := 0.0; END_IF;

(* First-Order Low-Pass Filter on Differential Pressure (Cutoff Frequency ~ 25 Hz) *)
rFilteredDiffPressure_bar := (0.78 * rFilteredDiffPressure_bar) + (0.22 * rDiffPressure_bar);

(* Compute Time Derivatives (dP/dt in bar/s, dOmega/dt in rpm/s) *)
rPressureRate_bar_per_s   := (rFilteredDiffPressure_bar - rPrevDiffPressure_bar) / 0.010;
rMotorDecelRate_rpm_per_s := (rPrevMotorSpeed_rpm - rMotorSpeed_rpm) / 0.010;
rPrevDiffPressure_bar     := rFilteredDiffPressure_bar;
rPrevMotorSpeed_rpm       := rMotorSpeed_rpm;

(* Real-Time Shaft Torque Estimation: tau = (Delta_P * V_g * eta_hm) / (20 * pi) *)
(* Swashplate Displacement scaling: 4.0 mA -> 28 cc/rev, 20.0 mA -> 160 cc/rev *)
rMotorDisplacement_cc := 28.0 + ((rSwashplateCurrent_mA - 4.0) / 16.0) * (160.0 - 28.0);
IF rMotorDisplacement_cc < 28.0 THEN rMotorDisplacement_cc := 28.0; END_IF;
IF rMotorDisplacement_cc > 160.0 THEN rMotorDisplacement_cc := 160.0; END_IF;

rEffectiveTorque_Nm := (rFilteredDiffPressure_bar * rMotorDisplacement_cc * 0.91) / 62.8318;
rCurrentHydraulicPower_kW := (rEffectiveTorque_Nm * rMotorSpeed_rpm * 0.1047197) / 1000.0;

(* Anti-Stall Hazard Index Computation: Quadratic Pressure Penalty + Lead Derivative *)
rStallHazardIndex := EXPT(rFilteredDiffPressure_bar / rMaxHydraulicPressure_bar, 2)
                   + (0.0035 * rPressureRate_bar_per_s)
                   + (0.00085 * rMotorDecelRate_rpm_per_s);

IF rStallHazardIndex < 0.0 THEN rStallHazardIndex := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rStallHazardIndex > 2.0 THEN rStallHazardIndex := 2.0; END_IF;

(* Active Anti-Stall Governor Intervention *)
IF rStallHazardIndex > 0.85 THEN
    bAntiStallActive := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Anti-Stall Torque Limiting Engaged *)
    
    (* De-stroke swashplate to shed hydrodynamic torque and restore motor speed *)
    rAntiStallTrim_mA   := (rStallHazardIndex - 0.85) * 18.5;
    rFeedAntiStallScale := 1.0 - ((rStallHazardIndex - 0.85) * 1.85);
    IF rFeedAntiStallScale < 0.0 THEN rFeedAntiStallScale := 0.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    bAntiStallActive := FALSE;
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND NOT 16#0008;
    rAntiStallTrim_mA   := 0.0;
    rFeedAntiStallScale := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Locked Rotor / Severe Stall Protection Watchdog Timer *)
tMotorStallTripTimer(IN := (rFilteredDiffPressure_bar > (rMaxHydraulicPressure_bar - 10.0)) AND (rMotorSpeed_rpm < 150.0),
                     PT := T#1200MS);
IF tMotorStallTripTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_HydraulicStallTrip := TRUE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Hydraulic Spindle Stall Trip *)
    bInternalTripLatch := TRUE; (* Lockout system to prevent hydraulic over-temp and wire snap *)
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 7: SEAFLOOR ACOUSTIC EMISSION (AE) STRUCTURAL BINDING DISCRIMINATOR
   Analyzes high-frequency elastic stress waves emitted by the rock chimney during kerf cutting.
   Distinguishes steady mineral grain micro-fracturing from lithostatic kerf pinching.
   Maintains a 32-sample sliding window to evaluate envelope mean, variance, and Kurtosis.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Update Circular FIFO Buffer with 2oo3 Voted AE Amplitude *)
arrAE_RingBuffer[iAE_BufferPointer] := rVotedAE_dB;
iAE_BufferPointer := iAE_BufferPointer + 1;
IF iAE_BufferPointer > 32 THEN iAE_BufferPointer := 1; END_IF;

(* Compute Statistical Moments across 32-Sample Window *)
rTempSum := 0.0;
FOR iIndex := 1 TO 32 DO
    rTempSum := rTempSum + arrAE_RingBuffer[iIndex];
END_FOR;
rAE_MomentMean := rTempSum / 32.0;

rTempVar := 0.0;
rTempSum := 0.0;
FOR iIndex := 1 TO 32 DO
    rTempDiff := arrAE_RingBuffer[iIndex] - rAE_MomentMean;
    rTempVar  := rTempVar + (rTempDiff * rTempDiff);
    rTempSum  := rTempSum + (rTempDiff * rTempDiff * rTempDiff * rTempDiff);
END_FOR;
rAE_MomentM2 := rTempVar / 32.0;
rAE_MomentM4 := rTempSum / 32.0;

(* Calculate Envelope Kurtosis: K = M4 / (M2^2 + eps) *)
IF rAE_MomentM2 > 0.01 THEN
    rAE_SlidingKurtosis := rAE_MomentM4 / ((rAE_MomentM2 * rAE_MomentM2) + 0.0001);
ELSE
    rAE_SlidingKurtosis := 3.0; (* Normal Gaussian baseline *)
END_IF;

(* Composite Lithostatic Binding Hazard Index *)
(* Combines amplitude spike, ring-down pulse density, and non-Gaussian leptokurtosis *)
rStructuralBindingIndex := ((rVotedAE_dB / rBindingAEThreshold_dB) * 45.0)
                         + ((rAE_RingDownCount_cps / 2500.0) * 35.0)
                         + ((rAE_SlidingKurtosis / 7.5) * 20.0);

IF rStructuralBindingIndex > 100.0 THEN rStructuralBindingIndex := 100.0; END_IF;

(* Binding Trip Logic & Debouncing *)
tBindingDebounceTimer(IN := (rStructuralBindingIndex > 82.0) OR (rVotedAE_dB > (rBindingAEThreshold_dB + 6.0)),
                      PT := T#250MS);

IF tBindingDebounceTimer.Q THEN
    bKerfBindingDetected := TRUE;
    bAlarm_AcousticBindingPinch := TRUE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Kerf Binding / Rock Pinch Alarm *)
ELSE
    bKerfBindingDetected := FALSE;
    bAlarm_AcousticBindingPinch := FALSE;
    wPrimaryAlarmWord := wPrimaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0010;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 8: BENTHIC MINERAL PARTICULATE TURBIDITY PURGE & SLURRY EVACUATION
   Controls high-pressure seawater pulsed flushing nozzles to clear heavy sulfide fines.
   Prevents kerf silting, wire bogging, and excessive hydrodynamic catenary drag.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculate Slurry Solid Volume Fraction in Cutting Kerf *)
rSlurrySolidFraction_pct := (rKerfTurbidity_NTU / 10000.0) * 28.5;
IF rSlurrySolidFraction_pct > 35.0 THEN rSlurrySolidFraction_pct := 35.0; END_IF;

(* Morrison Equation Hydrodynamic Catenary Drag on Moving Diamond Wire *)
(* F_drag = 0.5 * rho_slurry * Cd * A_proj * V_wire^2 *)
rHydrodynamicDragForce_N := 0.5 * rKerfSlurryDensity_kg_m3 * 1.35 * (0.0112 * 1.85)
                          * (rWireLinearSpeed_mps * rWireLinearSpeed_mps);

(* Determine Purge Jetting Demand *)
bSlurryEvacuationNeeded := (rKerfTurbidity_NTU > rSlurryPurgeThreshold_NTU)
                        OR (rSlurrySolidFraction_pct > 15.0)
                        OR bManualPurgeOverride;

IF bSlurryEvacuationNeeded THEN
    (* Modulated Pulsed Jetting Generator (Period = 250ms, Duty = 45%) *)
    rPurgePulseTimer_s := rPurgePulseTimer_s + 0.010;
    IF rPurgePulseTimer_s >= rPurgePulsePeriod_s THEN
        rPurgePulseTimer_s := 0.0;
        iPurgeCycleCounter := iPurgeCycleCounter + 1;
    END_IF;
    
    IF rPurgePulseTimer_s < (rPurgePulsePeriod_s * rPurgePulseDuty) THEN
        bPurgeValveActive := TRUE;
        rPurgeFlowRate_Lpm := 185.0; (* 185 L/min at 45 bar jetting differential *)
    ELSE
        bPurgeValveActive := FALSE;
        rPurgeFlowRate_Lpm := 25.0;  (* Continuous low-pressure shroud trickle *)
    END_IF;
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Turbidity Purge Active *)
ELSE
    bPurgeValveActive  := FALSE;
    rPurgeFlowRate_Lpm := 0.0;
    rPurgePulseTimer_s := 0.0;
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND NOT 16#0010;
END_IF;

(* Purge Timeout Watchdog: Alarm if high turbidity persists > 12 seconds continuously *)
tPurgeTimeoutTimer(IN := (rKerfTurbidity_NTU > (rSlurryPurgeThreshold_NTU + 1000.0)),
                   PT := T#12S);
IF tPurgeTimeoutTimer.Q THEN
    bAlarm_TurbidityPurgeFault := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Kerf Purge Ineffective *)
ELSE
    bAlarm_TurbidityPurgeFault := FALSE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0008;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 9: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED QUADRATIC COST SOLVER
   Active-Set Gradient Projection optimization minimizing tracking error and control effort:
   min J = 1/2 * DeltaU^T * H * DeltaU + Gradient^T * DeltaU
   subject to actuator saturation and rate-of-change constraints.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluate Output Tracking Error vs Setpoints *)
(* Output 1: Wire Speed (target nominal 24.0 m/s) *)
(* Output 2: Kerf Penetration *)
(* Output 3: Wire Catenary Tension *)
(* Output 4: Hydraulic Differential Pressure *)
vecY_err[1] := 24.0 - vecX_hat[1];
vecY_err[2] := rTargetFeedRate_mmpm - (vecX_hat[2] - vecU_prev[2]);
vecY_err[3] := rWireTensionSetpoint_N - vecX_hat[3];
vecY_err[4] := (rMaxHydraulicPressure_bar * 0.72) - vecX_hat[4];

(* Compute Linear Gradient Vector: Grad = - (C*B)^T * Q * Error + R * U_prev *)
arrGradient[1] := - (1.450 * arrWeightQ[1] * vecY_err[1])
                  - (0.150 * arrWeightQ[3] * vecY_err[3])
                  - (0.850 * arrWeightQ[4] * vecY_err[4])
                  + (arrWeightR[1] * vecU_prev[1]);

arrGradient[2] := - (0.000167 * arrWeightQ[2] * vecY_err[2])
                  - (0.280000 * arrWeightQ[3] * vecY_err[3])
                  - (0.420000 * arrWeightQ[4] * vecY_err[4])
                  + (arrWeightR[2] * vecU_prev[2]);

arrGradient[3] := - (24.500 * arrWeightQ[3] * vecY_err[3])
                  - (0.0500 * arrWeightQ[4] * vecY_err[4])
                  + (arrWeightR[3] * vecU_prev[3]);

(* Unconstrained Newton-Raphson Step: Delta_U = - Grad / H_diag *)
arrDeltaU[1] := - arrGradient[1] / arrHessianDiag[1];
arrDeltaU[2] := - arrGradient[2] / arrHessianDiag[2];
arrDeltaU[3] := - arrGradient[3] / arrHessianDiag[3];

(* Apply Actuator Slew Rate Constraints (Maximum Step per 10ms Scan Cycle) *)
IF arrDeltaU[1] > 0.45 THEN arrDeltaU[1] := 0.45; END_IF;
IF arrDeltaU[1] < -0.65 THEN arrDeltaU[1] := -0.65; END_IF;

IF arrDeltaU[2] > 0.25 THEN arrDeltaU[2] := 0.25; END_IF;
IF arrDeltaU[2] < -0.85 THEN arrDeltaU[2] := -0.85; END_IF;

IF arrDeltaU[3] > 1.20 THEN arrDeltaU[3] := 1.20; END_IF;
IF arrDeltaU[3] < -1.50 THEN arrDeltaU[3] := -1.50; END_IF;

(* Integrate Control Action: U(k) = U(k-1) + Delta_U(k) *)
rTrialControl_U1 := vecU_prev[1] + arrDeltaU[1];
rTrialControl_U2 := vecU_prev[2] + arrDeltaU[2];
rTrialControl_U3 := vecU_prev[3] + arrDeltaU[3];

(* Apply Actuator Box Saturation Constraints *)
(* U1: Swashplate Current [4.0 to 20.0 mA] *)
IF rTrialControl_U1 > 20.0 THEN rTrialControl_U1 := 20.0; END_IF;
IF rTrialControl_U1 < 4.0 THEN rTrialControl_U1 := 4.0; END_IF;

(* U2: Linear Feed Rate [0.0 to rTargetFeedRate_mmpm] *)
IF rTrialControl_U2 > rTargetFeedRate_mmpm THEN rTrialControl_U2 := rTargetFeedRate_mmpm; END_IF;
IF rTrialControl_U2 < 0.0 THEN rTrialControl_U2 := 0.0; END_IF;

(* U3: Catenary Tensioner Pressure [10.0 to 180.0 bar] *)
IF rTrialControl_U3 > 180.0 THEN rTrialControl_U3 := 180.0; END_IF;
IF rTrialControl_U3 < 10.0 THEN rTrialControl_U3 := 10.0; END_IF;

(* Store Vector Values *)
vecU[1] := rTrialControl_U1;
vecU[2] := rTrialControl_U2;
vecU[3] := rTrialControl_U3;
vecU_prev[1] := vecU[1];
vecU_prev[2] := vecU[2];
vecU_prev[3] := vecU[3];
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 10: ENERGETIC ROCK MODEL & DIAMOND BEAD MATRIX WEAR ESTIMATOR
   Calculates specific energy of comminution and integrates diamond impregnation volumetric loss.
   Generates advisory alarms as diamond diamond matrix approaches mechanical end-of-life.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Instantaneous Kerf Area Generation Rate [mm2/s] *)
(* Kerf width = 11.2 mm wire diameter + 1.8 mm diamond clearance = 13.0 mm *)
IF rFeedRateCommand_mmpm > 0.0 THEN
    rCumulativeKerfArea_mm2 := rCumulativeKerfArea_mm2 + (13.0 * (rFeedRateCommand_mmpm / 60.0) * 0.010);
END_IF;

(* Specific Cutting Energy: E_sp = Mechanical Power / Volumetric Removal Rate [J/mm3] *)
IF (rFeedRateCommand_mmpm > 1.0) AND (rCurrentHydraulicPower_kW > 0.5) THEN
    rKerfSpecificEnergy_J_mm3 := (rCurrentHydraulicPower_kW * 1000.0)
                               / (13.0 * (rFeedRateCommand_mmpm / 60.0) * 850.0);
ELSE
    rKerfSpecificEnergy_J_mm3 := 125.0; (* Nominal default for massive chalcopyrite/pyrite *)
END_IF;

(* Cumulative Diamond Bead Impregnation Matrix Wear Integration *)
(* Standard wear rate: ~ 0.00045% per 1,000 mm2 cut at nominal hardness *)
rCumulativeWearLoss_pct := (rCumulativeKerfArea_mm2 / 2500000.0) * 100.0;
rEstimatedWireWear_pct  := rCumulativeWearLoss_pct;

IF rCumulativeWearLoss_pct > 90.0 THEN
    bAlarm_DiamondWireWornOut := TRUE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Diamond Wire End of Life *)
ELSE
    bAlarm_DiamondWireWornOut := FALSE;
    wSecondaryAlarmWord := wSecondaryAlarmWord AND NOT 16#0010;
END_IF;
(* =========================================================================================
   MODULE 11: MULTI-STAGE MASTER STATE MACHINE (11 OPERATIONAL STATES)
   Coordinates structural anchoring, catenary pre-tensioning, spindle spin-up, pilot notch,
   MPC production cutting, high-turbidity purging, acoustic pinch retraction, and cut breakthrough.
   ========================================================================================= *)
(* Update State Dwell Time and First Scan Flag *)
IF iMasterState <> iPrevState THEN
    rStateDwellTime_s := 0.0;
    bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
    iPrevState        := iMasterState;
ELSE
    rStateDwellTime_s := rStateDwellTime_s + 0.010;
    bStateFirstScan   := FALSE;
END_IF;
iActiveSequenceStep := iMasterState;

CASE iMasterState OF

    0: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: IDLE STANDBY & TELEMETRY HANDSHAKE
          System de-energized, hydraulic valves in neutral, awaiting autosequence permissive.
          ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := 4.0;
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := 0.0;
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 15.0;
        bChimneyCutComplete    := FALSE;
        rRetractDistance_mm    := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord      := 16#0001; (* Bit 0: System Idle Standby *)

        IF bEnableAutosequence AND (NOT bInternalTripLatch) THEN
            iMasterState := 10; (* Proceed to TMR Sensor Audit *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 10: TMR SENSOR VALIDATION & AMBIENT CALIBRATION AUDIT
           Validates 2oo3 tension and AE channels, verifies 400 bar hydrostatic compensation.
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Sensor Audit Running *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := 4.0;
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := 0.0;
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 20.0;

        (* Audit Requirements: 2oo3 tension healthy, clamp locked, ambient pressure in range *)
        IF (iTensionHealthyCount >= 2) AND (iAEHealthyCount >= 2) AND (rClampPressure_bar > 180.0) THEN
            IF rStateDwellTime_s > 2.0 THEN
                iMasterState := 20; (* Advance to Clamping & Thermal Shielding *)
            END_IF;
        ELSIF rStateDwellTime_s > 6.0 THEN
            bInternalTripLatch := TRUE; (* Abort on sensor audit timeout *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 20: CLAMPING ENGAGEMENT & HYDROTHERMAL PLUME DIVERTER DEPLOYMENT
           Locks ROV rigid anchoring jaws to chimney base and deploys thermal plume shroud.
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Clamping & Shielding Engaged *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := 4.0;
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := 0.0;
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 30.0;

        (* Verify mechanical clamp locking pressure and thermal sensor baseline *)
        IF (rClampPressure_bar >= 210.0) AND (rStateDwellTime_s > 3.0) THEN
            iMasterState := 30; (* Advance to Wire Pre-Tensioning *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

           Pressurizes active tensioner cylinder to establish baseline 4,500 N catenary preload.

        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Wire Pre-Tensioning Active *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA := 4.0;
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm := 0.0;

        (* Smooth Pressure Ramp to establish 4,500 N tension *)
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 30.0 + (rStateDwellTime_s * 25.0);
        IF rTensionerPressure_bar > 85.0 THEN rTensionerPressure_bar := 85.0; END_IF;

        IF (rVotedTension_N >= 4200.0) AND (rStateDwellTime_s > 2.5) THEN
            iMasterState := 40; (* Advance to Hydraulic Motor Soft-Start *)
        ELSIF rStateDwellTime_s > 8.0 THEN
            bAlarm_TensionLossCritical := TRUE;
            bInternalTripLatch := TRUE; (* Timeout failing to build tension *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 40: HYDRAULIC SPINDLE SOFT-START & ACCELERATION RAMP
           Ramps variable displacement swashplate to reach nominal 24.0 m/s cutting velocity.
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Spindle Motor Accelerating *)
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := 0.0;
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 85.0;

        (* Proportional swashplate soft-start ramp (4.0 mA -> 14.5 mA over 4 seconds) *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA := 4.0 + (rStateDwellTime_s * 2.625);
        IF rSwashplateCurrent_mA > 14.5 THEN rSwashplateCurrent_mA := 14.5; END_IF;

        IF (rWireLinearSpeed_mps >= 22.0) AND (rStateDwellTime_s > 3.5) THEN
            iMasterState := 50; (* Advance to Pilot Kerf Engagement *)
        ELSIF rStateDwellTime_s > 10.0 THEN
            bAlarm_HydraulicStallTrip := TRUE;
            bInternalTripLatch := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    50: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
           STATE 50: PILOT KERF ENGAGEMENT & ACOUSTIC BASELINE PROFILING
           Creep feed rate forward (8 mm/min) to establish initial notch in rock chimney.
           Acoustically profiles contact point and captures mineral friability baseline.
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Pilot Notch Kerf Engagement *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := 15.0;
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := 8.0; (* Controlled creep feed *)
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 90.0;

        (* Detect Rock Contact via Acoustic Emission Step and Motor Pressure Rise *)
        IF (rVotedAE_dB > 58.0) AND (rDiffPressure_bar > 110.0) AND (rStateDwellTime_s > 4.0) THEN
            iMasterState := 60; (* Transfer to Full Closed-Loop Production Cutting *)
        ELSIF rStateDwellTime_s > 25.0 THEN

            IF rFeedPosition_mm > 5.0 THEN

    60: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

           Full multi-variable closed-loop control: MPC optimizes feed rate & swashplate current,
           Anti-Stall governor monitors torque saturation, and 2oo3 TMR secures wire tension.
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Full Production Cutting Active *)

        (* Modulate Actuators based on MPC Vectors with Anti-Stall Trim *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := vecU[1] - rAntiStallTrim_mA;
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := vecU[2] * rFeedAntiStallScale;
        rTensionerPressure_bar := vecU[3];

        (* Safety Envelope Clamping *)
        IF rSwashplateCurrent_mA < 4.0 THEN rSwashplateCurrent_mA := 4.0; END_IF;
        IF rSwashplateCurrent_mA > 20.0 THEN rSwashplateCurrent_mA := 20.0; END_IF;
        IF rFeedRateCommand_mmpm < 0.0 THEN rFeedRateCommand_mmpm := 0.0; END_IF;

        (* Transition Checks: High Turbidity Demands Deep Flush Sequence *)
        IF rKerfTurbidity_NTU > (rSlurryPurgeThreshold_NTU + 1500.0) THEN
            iMasterState := 70; (* Divert to Deep-Kerf Slurry Purge Sequence *)
        (* Severe Acoustic Binding Detected: Execute Pinch Mitigation Retract *)
        ELSIF bKerfBindingDetected AND bAutoReverseEnable THEN
            iMasterState := 80; (* Divert to Acoustic Binding Mitigation *)
        (* Cut Completion: Carriage Reaches Target Diameter *)
        ELSIF (rEstimatedKerfDepth_mm >= rTargetKerfDepth_mm) OR (rFeedPosition_mm >= rTargetKerfDepth_mm) THEN
            iMasterState := 90; (* Advance to Breakthrough Detection & Retract *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

           Temporarily pauses feed advance, runs high-pressure pulsed seawater jetting,
           and dithers wire speed to clear heavy polymetallic sulfide sludge from deep kerf.
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0200; (* Bit 9: Deep-Kerf Flushing In Progress *)
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := 2.0; (* Decelerate feed to minimum creep *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := 16.5; (* Maintain high wire velocity to throw slurry *)
        rTensionerPressure_bar := vecU[3] + 12.0; (* Stiffen tensioner against slurry drag *)

        (* Once Turbidity Drops below Permissive or After 5 Seconds Dwell *)
        IF (rKerfTurbidity_NTU < rSlurryPurgeThreshold_NTU) AND (rStateDwellTime_s > 3.0) THEN

        ELSIF rStateDwellTime_s > 8.0 THEN

           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0400; (* Bit 10: Binding Mitigation Auto-Retract Active *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := 8.0;   (* De-stroke motor to reduce mechanical stress *)
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := -25.0; (* High-speed carriage retraction *)
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 115.0; (* Stiffen tensioner to prevent catenary derailment *)
        bPurgeValveActive      := TRUE;  (* Force continuous flushing to lubricate kerf *)
        rPurgeFlowRate_Lpm     := 190.0;

        rRetractDistance_mm := rRetractDistance_mm + (25.0 / 60.0 * 0.010);

        (* Verify clearance: Acoustic emission settles, carriage retracted >= 15 mm *)
        IF (rRetractDistance_mm >= 15.0) AND (rVotedAE_dB < (rBindingAEThreshold_dB - 10.0)) THEN
            rRetractDistance_mm := 0.0;
            iMasterState := 50; (* Re-approach carefully through pilot notch *)
        ELSIF rStateDwellTime_s > 6.0 THEN
            (* If binding persists after 6s retract, trigger trip to protect wire *)
            bInternalTripLatch := TRUE;

    90: (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0800; (* Bit 11: Cut Breakthrough & Tool Retraction *)
        bChimneyCutComplete := TRUE;

        rSwashplateCurrent_mA := 14.0 - (rStateDwellTime_s * 2.5);
        IF rSwashplateCurrent_mA < 4.0 THEN rSwashplateCurrent_mA := 4.0; END_IF;

        (* Full Speed Carriage Return *)
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := -45.0;
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 35.0;

        IF (rFeedPosition_mm <= 5.0) AND (rStateDwellTime_s > 6.0) THEN
            iMasterState := 0; (* Return to Idle Standby - Mission Complete *)
        END_IF;

           Safe parked state following hardwired SIL-3 E-Stop or critical mechanical fault.
           --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        wSystemStatusWord      := 16#8000; (* Bit 15: Emergency Trip Lockout *)
        rSwashplateCurrent_mA  := 4.0;
        rFeedRateCommand_mmpm  := 0.0;
        rTensionerPressure_bar := 0.0;
        bPurgeValveActive      := FALSE;
        rPurgeFlowRate_Lpm     := 0.0;

        IF bResetFaults AND bEmergencyStop AND (NOT bInternalTripLatch) THEN
            iMasterState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;
